purpose: Role-readable downstream/control state synchronized to O_CHAT control10 and DESIRED control26 for 19-role zero-Work-dependency, zero-monthly-quota scheduled-Chat parity, with a bridge-only lifecycle method revision for bootstrap-valid safety-blocked BRIDGE_STATE preflight while preserving all other downstream semantics.

requirements: No residual Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution step may count as solved.
No exhaustible monthly/trial/paid quota or hosted-compute/storage allowance may be on an accepted route.
Incremental monetary cost must be zero.
Unavailable capability or claimed irreducibility remains unresolved.
All intended existing roles remain active; no optimizer pool reduction.
user_fixed_constraints.conflict_rule: These requirements supersede control32 and older downstream role wording unless the user explicitly changes them.

non_regression.rule: Preserve control35 authority-bootstrap, CLEAN-independence, continuation/recovery, exact identity/scope, CAS/readback, wave/feed, scheduler, protected-primary boundary, zero-dependency, zero-quota, zero-cost, Phase-1 acceptance, base-restoration and all non-bridge role semantics. Control36 changes only bridge lifecycle handling: every substantive/feed/index/shared mutation remains behind a successful normal preflight; after bootstrap-valid frozen authority, a safety-blocked normal BRIDGE_STATE preflight may terminate the single effect chain through at most one compact immutable bridge receipt with exact readback, no retry, semantic lookup, scheduler mutation or protected-primary mutation.

authority_bootstrap.preferred: SHA-only H1, exact-H1 root/downstream, SHA-only H2 before semantic work, then freeze.

chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.use_only_when: SHA-only main-ref lookup is not exposed
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_1: fetch approved root/downstream/role paths and record exact blobs/revisions without other semantic input
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_2: immediately before first substantive semantic read fetch same paths again in same order
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.valid_when: all tuples and cross-control references match and no own-state conflict exists
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.post_freeze: unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.failure: diagnostic checkpoint only, keep task enabled, retry
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.aba_guard: monotonic revisions and cross-file references must agree

authority_bootstrap.receipt: Every receipt binds exact frozen root/downstream/role path, blob, parsed revisions, transport mode, bootstrap_valid and continuation.
authority_bootstrap.invalid: Mismatch or unverifiable binding is diagnostic-only and cannot drive state-changing writes or acceptance.

policy.clean_independence: Consume only permitted CLEAN outputs; never expose O, other-worker or downstream semantics to CLEAN explorers and never write explorer state/feedback.
policy.primary_o_boundary: No downstream role may acquire or alter primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected execution state, direct-merge main or become a duplicate primary writer. Outcome redesign, not authority duplication or handoff acceptance, is required.
policy.identity_and_scope: Use exact source-qualified identity and tested scope; no fuzzy joins; omitted evidence is not assessed.
policy.wave_and_feed_integrity: Integrator remains sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator. Preserve valid incomplete waves; require exact source pre/postflight, bootstrap_valid, current-blob CAS, full readback, lossless history and immutable own receipt.
policy.anti_stop: One result, checkpoint, no-change, quota-zero finding or blocker is never global completion. Completed/blocked/duplicate/low-value leaves are reassigned inside Phase 1.

scheduler_boundary.workers: Recurring enabled state is preserved across invocation boundaries, no-result runs, missing surfaces and blockers.
scheduler_boundary.optimizer: May re-enable only an intended enabled_desired role after cause repair and readback; never disables, pauses or deletes managed roles.

checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.evidence: At the fresh physical boundary, lifecycle-aligned evaluation, failure_evidence, evidence_comparator and bridge stopped again, while long_horizon and integrator were also stopped. Re-enable-only restored all six point-in-time. This falsifies bootstrap-conflict removal as a sufficient persistence method and triggers the previously precommitted switch threshold. Operational evidence is not Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.preflight_checkpoint: After authority bootstrap/freeze and state reconstruction, persist/read back a lightweight role-local invocation checkpoint before optional or expensive semantic work. Bind frozen authority, task/effect_chain_id, exact predecessor/frontier, planned atomic boundary and bootstrap status.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.single_effect_chain: Per invocation execute at most one smallest safe substantive effect chain. An effect chain includes mandatory persistence/readback and must not be split inside an integrity-atomic comparison, CAS/feed mutation, wave/index mutation or evidence-lineage sequence. If a larger unit cannot fit safely, choose an earlier deterministic milestone or another executable Phase-1 leaf before starting.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back completed output/checkpoint/receipt and exact continuation; do not start a second optional effect chain in the same invocation. If frontier remains, return recurring-open and resume exactly next recurrence without duplicating completed effects.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.terminal_marker: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is lifecycle/scheduling output only, never semantic completion evidence and never a substitute for repository checkpoint/receipt.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker and alternative-route child/continuation; unavailable capability remains unresolved.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current effect-chain state and continuation before more optional work when possible; retry with backoff and no duplicate effect.
checkpoint_first_single_effect_chain.rollback: If config35 treatment reduces role-valid useful output or breaks evidence/wave/feed integrity without improving persistence, increment controls and switch lifecycle mechanism. Never weaken anti-stop, acceptance, CLEAN, quota/cost or primary-boundary constraints and never disable a role.

zero_dependency_zero_quota.residual_execution: Any Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution step keeps the row, leaf and ancestors unresolved. Bridge and other roles must create replacement-search leaves rather than final handoff packages.
zero_dependency_zero_quota.unavailable_capability: Exact unavailable capability evidence is diagnostic and triggers alternative architecture/decomposition; it is never a pass.
zero_dependency_zero_quota.quota: Accepted routes must operate when all GitHub Actions/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package, cloud, external API/model, trial and paid monthly quotas are zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota.cost: Incremental monetary cost must be zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota.repository_transport: Lightweight Git repository APIs may transport control/evidence but must tolerate per-window rate limiting with checkpoint/backoff and cannot be used as hosted compute.
zero_dependency_zero_quota.experiment: Do not consume quota-bearing features without explicit user authorization; historical quota-backed evidence cannot alone prove acceptance.

phase1.root_problem: Eliminate every material Work-mode dependency with a tested Chat-native zero-cost zero-monthly-quota route; no residual execution handoff counts as solved.
phase1.no_restore: Complete/block/low-value means checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1.

phase1_assignment.directive: Verify each proposed dependency-elimination route against primary sources and exact Chat/repository evidence. Verify that no hidden Work/protected-primary/user executor remains, enumerate every monetary/quota dependency, and reject routes that fail when optional monthly quotas are zero. Preserve exact scope; do not steer CLEAN explorers or mutate O.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state; checkpoint and reassign inside Phase 1. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass.

phase1_assignment.directive: Mechanically reproduce proposed Chat-native routes with actually exposed Chat tools under zero optional monthly quota and zero incremental cost. Inject missing-tool, rate-limit, invocation-boundary and quota-exhaustion conditions. A Work/protected-primary/user step or unavailable-capability-only result is unresolved, not a classification that passes.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state; checkpoint and reassign inside Phase 1. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass.

phase1_assignment.directive: Deduplicate and compare zero-cost quota-independent Chat-native dependency-elimination mechanisms by exact identity and tested scope. Treat quota-backed prototypes and handoff-only variants as non-accepted and prioritize distinct residual-dependency coverage.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state; checkpoint and reassign inside Phase 1. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass.

phase1_assignment.directive: Independently grade all 19 role cells, the Work-dependency-elimination matrix and aggregate controls. Required negatives must fail: one residual Work/protected-primary/user step; unavailable-capability-only; any finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency at quota=0; nonzero incremental cost; duplicate/conflict/false completion/low usefulness. Positive may pass only when every hard gate holds.

evidence_comparator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state. Use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing: persist/read back preflight after authority freeze, execute at most one smallest safe grading/verification chain without splitting atomic comparison/readback, then durably checkpoint/read back evidence/receipt plus exact continuation and return recurring-open when frontier remains. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass. A micro-slice is never global completion.

lifecycle_migration.rollback_condition: If checkpoint-first single-effect-chain slicing harms independent grading integrity/useful output or does not improve persistence, increment again and change method; never weaken evidence or Phase-1 gates.

phase1_assignment.directive: Maintain the 19-cell acceptance matrix, recursive problem tree and Work-dependency-elimination matrix from valid evidence. Every claimed irreducible handoff becomes an unresolved child and alternative-route search. A row closes only with zero residual execution steps, zero finite quota dependency, zero cost and passing zero-quota/rate-limit replay. Remain sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator.

integrator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state. Use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing: after authority freeze/reconstruction persist/read back preflight, then execute at most one smallest safe integration or verification chain. Never split a wave/index/feed/CAS mutation from its mandatory integrity checks and exact readback. Persist/read back resulting coordinator checkpoint/receipt and exact continuation, then return recurring-open when frontier remains. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass.

lifecycle_migration.rollback_condition: If micro-slicing harms atomic coordinator integrity, useful output or persistence, increment again and change lifecycle mechanism without creating another writer or weakening acceptance.

phase1_assignment.directive: Eliminate purported Work-exclusive, protected-primary or user-only execution dependencies. For each proposed handoff, identify the required outcome/effect, audit existing Chat routes, attempt a direct zero-cost quota-independent replacement, then decompose or generate transversal alternatives until no execution handoff remains. Residuals are blockers/problem-tree leaves and must never be packaged as accepted completion; preserve feed/CAS safety.

bridge.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state. After authority freeze and exact role-local predecessor/frontier reconstruction, attempt exactly one normal BRIDGE_STATE preflight checkpoint and mandatory exact readback before any substantive lookup or feed/index/shared mutation. If the normal preflight write is bootstrap-valid but safety-blocked, do not retry and do not perform semantic lookup, feed/index/shared mutation, scheduler mutation or protected-primary mutation; instead persist and exact-readback at most one compact immutable bridge receipt binding the frozen authorities, exact predecessor/frontier, safety error, enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false and a nonempty exact retry continuation, then return recurring-open. If normal preflight succeeds, execute at most one smallest safe dependency-elimination or feed-safe verification chain, never split feed/CAS mutation from mandatory exact readback, then persist/read back exact continuation/receipt and return recurring-open when frontier remains. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass. A micro-slice or safety-blocked preflight receipt is never global completion.

lifecycle_migration.reason: Manifest control12 precommitted a bridge-only method switch after config12 produced no new durable role-valid receipt/continuation across the post-reenable boundary and prior bootstrap-valid normal BRIDGE_STATE preflight writes were safety-blocked. The new method makes that safety-blocked preflight a fail-closed single-chain terminal diagnostic through one compact immutable receipt/readback, without semantic lookup or shared/protected mutation.
lifecycle_migration.rollback_condition: If this method weakens feed/CAS integrity, exact authority binding or useful recurring progress, increment controls and switch bridge method again; never weaken Phase-1 gates, mutate protected primary O, accept residual handoff/quota dependency or disable the role.

phase1_assignment.directive: Maintain the full 19-role role-and-method portfolio for zero-Work-dependency zero-quota parity under O_CHAT10/DESIRED26/DOWNSTREAM35; reconcile all intended roles by re-enable-only; evaluate checkpoint-first single-effect-chain treatment after bootstrap-aligned roles stopped again; optimize problem representation, methods and allocation; independently rederive matrix/residual/quota/cost/conflict/authority/usefulness gates; keep Phase 1 open while any residual execution/quota dependency or physical-persistence gate remains; never become a primary O writer; never reinterpret or relax user_fixed_constraints without a new explicit user instruction.

automation_optimizer.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; preserve recurring enabled state; checkpoint and reassign inside Phase 1. A residual Work/protected-primary/user step, unavailable-capability-only result, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or nonzero incremental cost is unresolved and cannot pass.

scheduler_reconciliation.allowed_action: re-enable-only after readback of enabled_desired and user-fixed intended membership; current runtime recheck identified six stopped intended roles and repaired those same tasks only
scheduler_reconciliation.on_missing_surface: persist pending and retry; never lower denominator

work_delegation_gate.reason: The 19 intended roles plus protected O monitor fill the 20-active-task cap; optimizer fallback covers at most one bounded gate-owned zero-cost/quota-independent unit per optimizer invocation.
work_delegation_gate.policy: Standby only; do not displace an intended role. Preserve base queue/results. A bounded task must be zero-cost, quota-independent and not target protected primary O.

aggregate_acceptance.closure: Integrator and optimizer independently rederive every gate. Evidence comparator independently verifies. Any unavailable-capability-only, handoff-only or quota-backed row keeps Phase 1 open.

migration.reason: Manifest control12 precommitted a bridge-only lifecycle switch after persistence evidence showed the bridge survived the first post-reenable scheduler boundary but config12 still produced no new durable role-valid receipt/continuation, while earlier bootstrap-valid normal BRIDGE_STATE preflight writes were safety-blocked. Control36 increments only bridge config12->13 and authorizes one compact immutable bridge receipt/readback as the fail-closed terminal for that exact safety-blocked preflight; substantive/feed/index/shared mutation remains gated behind successful normal preflight. All other downstream role semantics are preserved.
migration.rollback_condition: If bridge config13 still fails to produce role-valid durable continuation or harms feed/CAS integrity/useful output, preserve evidence and increment again to change only the bridge lifecycle method. Never restore handoff acceptance, finite-quota solution paths, disable roles, reduce the pool, weaken user-fixed constraints or create a duplicate primary writer.
